acceptedAnswer.text: We work from Thane, Mumbai and Indore, and serve brands across India. Our head office is in Thane, at 4th Floor, Office No. 105, WeWork, Zenia Building, Hiranandani Business Park, Thane 400607, Maharashtra.

mainEntity.name: Do you publish an address for Mumbai and Indore?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The only street address we publish is our Thane head office. For a meeting in Mumbai or Indore, book a call and we will agree where and when.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be in one of these cities to work with you?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most work runs on video calls, shared reports and WhatsApp for quick questions, so your business can be anywhere in India.

mainEntity.name: Why have a page for each city?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because a business in each city faces a different problem. The three pages say what that problem is and how we work on it, and they are written separately rather than copied with the city name swapped.

mainEntity.name: What do you do for a business in a city?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verify each place on Google, complete the profile, handle reviews, build a page for the place and report calls, directions and enquiries. Ads are added where they suit. See Google Business Profile optimisation.

mainEntity.name: Do you guarantee a top local ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee a ranking, a review or a timeline. We commit to the work in the monthly scope and report what we can observe.
